name: hEvo benchmark suite
description: A set of genomic evaluation workflows for DNA sequence representations, regulatory prediction, variant-effect scoring, ancestry and evolutionary analyses, with numerical source tables.

attributes.task: Sequence representations (NT tasks, Genomic Benchmark, URE); regulatory prediction (DeepSEA multi-label with LoRA); variant effects (ClinVar, candidate causal and rare variants, DDD, MPRA, retrospective reclassification) using paired-allele scoring; ancestry (population embeddings, classification and ancestry-proportion regression); evolution (HAR/HAQER classification and adaptive-allele preference); training and efficiency (corpus and windowing ablations).
limitations: Baseline models use model-specific native scoring, so scores are not directly comparable without the evaluation guide.
Adaptive-allele preference compares selected versus other alleles.
Frozen-backbone probes and paired-allele scoring are separate protocols.
Source-specific terms apply to the underlying data.
